reason: The written quote with no extra fees on arrival is exactly what I worry about with my Instagram pages, and paying shipping only when it reaches my door feels safer than a deposit to a page that disappears. I'd try one small order first to see if they keep their word.
objection: 21,000 IQD in fees on 30,000 shoes is almost as much as the shoes, and I don't really know how to find things on Taobao myself; the Instagram pages just show me the photos and I pick.
